description: This file is a shell script that automates setup, build, patching, and testing processes for the entservices application, specifically focusing on the AppGateway component and its dependencies. It includes logic for cloning repositories, applying patches, configuring and building various components via CMake, installing plugins, and running tests with coverage analysis.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Prints informational messages prefixed with '==> ' for standard output.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Prints warning messages prefixed with 'WARNING: ' to standard error.

methods.name: err
methods.description: Prints error messages prefixed with 'ERROR: ' to standard error.

methods.name: have_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command is available in the current PATH.

methods.name: is_root
methods.description: Determines if the script is running with root privileges.

methods.name: apt_can_run
methods.description: Checks if apt-get can be executed, either as root or via sudo.

methods.name: apt_get
methods.description: Runs apt-get with specified arguments, using sudo if necessary.

methods.name: run_best_effort
methods.description: Runs a command, captures its exit code, and logs a warning if it fails, without terminating the script.

methods.name: git_noninteractive_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables for non-interactive git operations.

methods.name: ensure_git_checkout_ref
methods.description: Checks out a specific git ref (branch/tag/remote) in a repo directory.

methods.name: ensure_repo_clone_and_checkout
methods.description: Clones a repository if absent, or fetches and checks out a specific ref if present.

methods.name: apply_patch_dir
methods.description: Applies a patch to a repository directory, handling idempotency and patch state.

methods.name: build_dir_configured
methods.description: Checks if a build directory has been configured by presence of CMakeCache.txt.

methods.name: is_component_installed
methods.description: Heuristic to determine if a component is installed based on directory contents.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_install
methods.description: Configures, builds, and installs a component via CMake with explicit generator and prefix.
